## Checklist

- [ ] The tests, lint and typecheck pass locally (`make check`; `cd frontend && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` for frontend changes).
- [ ] A change in behaviour updates its document under `docs/` (and `docs/diagrams/` for an architecture change).
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, private links or data whose licence forbids redistribution.
- [ ] New third-party code or data is listed with its licence (`NOTICE`, `REUSE.toml`, the data directory's `LICENSES.md`).
- [ ] I have signed the [CLA](https://github.com/CodeWithJuber/mizan/blob/main/CLA.md) (the CLA check asks on the first pull request).
- [ ] If an AI tool wrote part of this, the description says which.
